title: The One to the North
subtitle: 江河湖海 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）
meta: 主题语境：江河湖海（自然生态·海洋与河流）　|　核心词汇：bay　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 bay 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 my uncle sailed into ① a bay he had been told about for eleven years, and he said the telling was better than the water. The ② bay, meaning the water and not the story, was nine miles wide and too shallow for anything he owned; a bay, he said, is the only piece of sea that is judged by how well it keeps a secret.

Every ③ bay on that coast had a different wind, and the ④ bay to the north, meaning the one with the rocks and not either of those, was the only one he never entered twice. A bay, my grandmother said, is nine parts shelter and one part an exit you can find in the dark; my uncle said the shelter is the part they write about.

My mother meant the other thing entirely: she said ⑤ bay was the whole of the stable, meaning the stall and not the water. The ⑥ bay, meaning the compartment and not any of that, is the only room in a building that is named after the animal and not the man; a bay, she said, is either a piece of sea or the only word that means both a harbour and a stall. He said the sea came first.

By 1971 the ⑦ bay had become a photograph on a calendar, and the calendar had become an argument about who had been there first. The ⑧ bay of the whole thing, my uncle wrote in July, was eleven years of telling and nine miles of water; a bay, he said, is either the water he sailed into or the reason he never sold the boat. She said the boat was the expensive half.

The ⑨ bay I remember is the one to the north, which he entered once and described for thirty years. A ⑩ bay, my grandmother said in 1973, is the only place that improves by being described; every bay, she said, is a shelter that has agreed to look like a story. He said the story was the only part that survived.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 海湾（指那片水域，与故事相对）
C. 固定搭配：sail into a bay 驶入一个海湾
D. n. 海湾（指那片海岸上每一个）
E. n. 海湾（指北边那一个）
F. n. 马厩隔间；分隔间（指马厩里那一格）
G. n. 隔间（抽象：那种分隔出来的空间）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a bay he had been told about for eleven years
The bay, meaning the water and not the story
bay was the whole of the stable
the bay had become a photograph on a calendar
The bay of the whole thing
A bay, my grandmother said in 1973

answers.why: sail into a bay 意为“驶入一个海湾”，1957 年叔叔驶进一个他听了十一年的海湾。
bay 意为“海湾”，指那片水域而不是那个故事，它宽九英里，浅得容不下他拥有的任何一条船。
bay 指那片海岸上每一个海湾，每一个的风都不一样。
bay 指北边那一个（有礁石的那一个），是唯一他从不进第二次的。
bay 意为“马厩隔间、分隔间”，指马厩里那一格，母亲说 bay 就是马厩的全部。
bay 为抽象用法，指那种分隔出来的空间，是一栋建筑里唯一以动物而不是以人命名的房间。
bay 意为“海湾”，到 1971 年这个 bay 成了挂历上的一张照片。
bay 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，叔叔七月写道，整件事权衡下来是十一年的讲述和九英里的海水。
bay 意为“海湾”，我记得的是北边那一个，他进去过一次，然后讲了三十年。
bay 为抽象总称，祖母说海湾是唯一会因为被人讲述而变好的地方。
